title: seseli veitchii
intro: Seseli veitchii, commonly known as Veitch's sesame fern or false pennyroyal, is a type of flowering plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It is known for its potential health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing stress and anxiety, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Seseli veitchii include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative properties, making it a useful natural remedy for various health concerns. The bioactive constituents of Seseli veitchii include sesquiterpenes, coumarins, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
